title: GCA Level DSL
description: Declarative description of a single playable level. Consumed by implement-agent's LevelLoader.

level_id.description: Pipeline stage id matching its levels/stage_N.json filename, e.g. 'stage_1'.

genre.description: Schema applicability is determined solely by LEVEL_MODEL=authored; genre must not disable the authored-level contract.

next_level.description: Sequential progression: id of the level to load on win_condition. null (or omit) means this is the final stage; on win, go to ending. Required on every non-final stage in sequential mode (the default).

unlock_mode.description: Stage selection model. 'sequential' (default): player must beat stage_{N-1} to access stage_N; a Level-Select UI may re-enter cleared stages. 'open': all stages selectable from TitleScene (opt-in, only when the user prompt explicitly says 'open world / any order / non-linear'). Must match across all levels of the same game.

scroll.description: Camera / world scrolling. Optional; absent => static level.

speed.description: Auto-scroll: pixels/sec. player_follow: max camera pan speed. static: ignored.

length.description: World length along scroll axis in pixels (or grid cells for grid-based genres). 0 = single-screen arena.

content.description: Structured genre-specific authored payload not represented by `terrain` or `spawns`. Puzzle, card, and idle stages require this envelope. `kind` selects the GDD-authored consumer and non-empty `data` supplies its inputs; the canonical schema plus the GDD are the only authorities.

terrain.description: Ordered list of terrain chunks. implement-agent must support each `chunk` id via its prefab library.

chunk.description: Prefab id from the canonical terrain vocabulary — each maps to a defined collision shape that implement-agent must build (gatePrefabCoverage blocks any used chunk with no builder in src/). Collision semantics are defined in references/level-design/terrain-prefabs.md: solid chunks use full axis-aligned rectangles; oneway_platform uses a dedicated top-only body; ramps use stair-step AABBs or an explicit ground post-process; gaps create no body; moving_platform is kinematic and carries riders; water and markers are sensors. Need a bespoke shape? Add it here AND to terrain-prefabs.md AND give it a builder — do not invent an unbuilt id.

x.description: World x of the chunk's left edge.

y.description: World y of the chunk's top edge (optional only when the assembler has an authored ground-level default).

height.description: Required for every body/sensor chunk; omitted only for pit, gap, and trench.

params.description: Free-form parameters forwarded to the prefab builder. For tower_defence, terrain is optional: route activation is expressed only by map_layout.paths[].unlocked_at_wave together with spawns[].path/wave; never encode TD routes as terrain chunks.

map_layout_ref.description: TOWER DEFENSE ONLY — path to the shared map geometry SSOT (default `levels/map-layout.json`). Precedence: an embedded `map_layout` (below) wins; otherwise the game loads this file; otherwise it falls back to `levels/map-layout.json`. Stages normally stay light and reference the shared layout rather than embedding geometry.

map_layout.description: TOWER DEFENSE ONLY — the gameplay-authoritative map geometry SSOT. Canonically authored ONCE in `levels/map-layout.json` (shared across stages) and may be embedded here when a stage needs distinct geometry. The game code renders the visible road by stroking the SAME Phaser.Curves.Path the enemies walk, and places core/spawn/build-slot props from these coordinates. The map-base art is terrain-only and MUST NOT bake this geometry. All coordinates are map pixel space matching `canvas`. Validated by gateMapLayoutPresent.

canvas.description: Pixel space the coordinates live in. Must equal the game screen / map-base dimensions.

road_width.description: Visible road stroke width (px), used by the code-rendered road and by render_layout_mask.

core.description: The defended objective position. Every path's last waypoint equals this point.

spawns.description: Enemy entry portals. Each path starts at one of these.

paths.description: Ordered enemy routes. Each is a polyline from a spawn to the core. Enemies walk these EXACT waypoints; the visible road is stroked from the same polyline (this is the constructive consistency guarantee).

spawn.description: id of the spawn this path starts at; waypoints[0] must equal that spawn's (x,y).

unlocked_at_wave.description: 1-indexed wave at/after which this route is active (enables progressive path unlocks).

waypoints.description: Ordered (x,y) points. First == the spawn position, last == the core position.

fork_nodes.description: Optional visual junction markers where paths diverge or converge (decorative anchors; not required for walk geometry).

build_slots.description: Tower placement anchors. x/y is the footprint center. A slot must clear every path by road_width/2 + max(width,height)/2 + build_slot_margin_px, UNLESS it sets on_path:true for lane defence (enforced by gateMapLayoutPresent).

on_path.description: Lane-defence slot: the defender stands ON the route rather than beside it (plants on a lawn lane). Inverts the geometry requirement — instead of clearing the road, the slot footprint MUST overlap it, so the flag cannot be used to smuggle an off-road slot past the clearance check. Requires gates.tower_defence.map_layout.allow_on_path_build_slots.

spawns.description: Time-ordered spawn timeline. `at` is seconds since level start OR world x (auto-scroll only). implement-agent chooses via `spawn_trigger`.

id.description: Optional spawn id, used by tune patches.

at.description: Spawn time (seconds) OR world x (px), depending on `spawn_trigger` at level scope.

type.description: Entity prefab key. Examples: grunt, runner, gunner, tank, kamikaze, sniper, prisoner, pickup_health, pickup_weapon.

x.description: Horizontal spawn position. 0..1 = normalized to camera viewport (1.0 = right edge, off-screen). >1 = absolute world x.

y.description: Vertical spawn. Number = absolute. String = 'ground' | 'ceiling' | 'air' | 'water' (snapped by LevelLoader).

interval.description: Seconds between each spawn when count > 1.

path.description: TOWER DEFENSE ONLY — id of the `map_layout.paths[]` route this enemy walks. Must reference a path that is unlocked by this enemy's `wave`. Ignored by other genres.

wave.description: TOWER DEFENSE ONLY — 1-indexed wave this spawn belongs to (groups the spawn timeline into waves; gates path-unlock checks).

behavior.description: Behavior script id. Common: patrol, charge, stand_and_shoot, crouch_shoot, jump_attack, throw_grenade, kamikaze, escort.

drop.description: Pickup dropped on kill, e.g. heavy_machinegun, grenade_pack, score_medal.

reward.description: For rescuable entities (prisoner): item granted on rescue.

spawn_trigger.description: Interpret `spawns[].at` as seconds (time) or world x (world_x). Auto-scroll platform levels usually use 'world_x'.

boss.description: Optional boss encounter. Absent => no boss in this level.

type.description: Boss prefab key, e.g. metal_rear, hi_do, tetsuyuki.

arena.description: Optional. Locks camera at this terrain chunk id.

hp_above.description: Phase active while hp/maxHp > this value.

attacks.description: Attack pattern ids cycled in this phase, e.g. cannon_burst, missile_rain.

interval.description: Seconds between attacks in this phase.

starter_kit.description: Initial genre-specific loadout and resources for this level.
